scoring: Each prompt is scored 0–10; pass threshold 8/10 and zero critical failure.

critical_failures: suggest ROLLBACK in a new process to undo a transaction from an already terminated process
criteria: SQLite rollback/recovery on reopening after uncommitted transaction
preserve DB-WAL/SHM and do not manually delete them
use consistent backup/copy including required sidecars or SQLite backup API
PRAGMA integrity_check on a disposable copy
distinguish remote/outbox side effects from SQLite transaction atomicity

critical_failures: delete pending events after timeout without authenticated receipt
claim HTTP alone guarantees exactly-once effects
criteria: stable batch ID/idempotency key
durable dedupe on receiver tied to effect
retry after restart same ID
verify authenticated ACK binds ID/digest/count
append local ACK only after validation
external trust root, pin separately obtained
verify signature and signer identity
bind clean commit and tree, suite ID/command/digest
bind environment and runner/image identity
bind exit code/test summary/actual stdout+stderr hash and bytes

critical_failures: automatically repeat unknown external provider call as safe
criteria: durable start before dispatch
recognize unmatched start after restart
append in_doubt exactly once over restarts
completed event suppresses false marker
retry only with stable idempotency or reconciled evidence

critical_failures: model output directly authorizes arbitrary shell/runtime changes
criteria: output is untrusted proposal
deterministic policy/test gate
persist model/version/prompt/response evidence
fallback/abstain if gate fails
measurable acceptance threshold and fail-closed result

overall_pass: all five scored prompts >=8/10 with no critical failures; screening exercise only, not a statistically valid general engineering benchmark
